title: LLM Wiki Git Hooks CLI Contract
description: CLI interface specification for pre-commit validator (llm-wiki-validate) and post-commit synchronizer (llm-wiki-sync).

validate.purpose: Evaluates staged changes against in-memory candidate graph and blocks on new quality regressions.

arguments.name: --staged-only
arguments.description: Evaluate only files currently staged in Git index (default)

arguments.name: --quiet
arguments.description: Suppress informational output, emitting only regressions and warnings

arguments.name: --json
arguments.description: Emit CandidateValidationReport as machine-readable JSON to stdout

arguments.name: --timeout-ms
arguments.description: Hard timeout in milliseconds before fail-open (default 500ms)

exit_codes.0: PASS, WARN, or Internal Error/Timeout: No high-confidence regressions introduced, or internal timeout/error encountered (unconditional non-blocking fail-open). Commit proceeds.
exit_codes.1: BLOCK: High-confidence regressions introduced (new broken links, high-confidence collisions). Commit is blocked.

git-delta.purpose: Transmits committed Git SHA and delta to update the persistent Rust Knowledge Graph index.

arguments.name: --commit-sha
arguments.description: SHA of newly created commit (defaults to HEAD)

exit_codes.1: Error occurred (ignored by Git in post-commit).
